question: The name of Ustad Vilayat Khan is associated with which of the following Indian musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan:-**

 
 
• **He is a renowned Indian classical musician who was a sitar player.**
 
• He was born in Gauripur, West Bengal, and belonged to the Imdadkhani gharana of music.
 
• He was considered a master of the sitar and was known for his unique style and improvisations.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santoor:-**

 
 
• It is a hammered dulcimer instrument that originated in Kashmir and is played with mallets.
 
 
 
• **Bansuri:-**
 
 
• It is a bamboo flute that is commonly used in Indian classical music and is played by blowing across the mouthpiece.
 
 
 
• **Tabla:-**
 
 
• It is a pair of drums that are used in Indian classical music and are played by striking them with the hands.
